questions.q: Given that $i$ is the imaginary unit, which of the following numbers is equal to $(7 + 4i)^2$?
questions.explain: Expand the binomial: $(7 + 4i)^2 = (7)^2 + 2(7)(4i) + (4i)^2$. This simplifies to $49 + 56i + 16i^2$. Remember that the imaginary unit squared is $i^2 = -1$. Substitute $-1$ into the expression: $49 + 56i + 16(-1) = 49 - 16 + 56i = 33 + 56i$.
